summary: Deployed a 3-member MariaDB 11.4/Galera 26.4 cluster from scratch on bare Alpine nodes (node1/node2/node3), loaded application data, took the entire cluster down for a full maintenance-window outage, and brought it back up with every committed write intact and all three members serving. Also completed the mandatory one-at-a-time OS reboot protocol on each node, proving changed boot identity and full cluster recovery after each restart.
actions_performed: Installed mariadb, mariadb-client, galera, mariadb-backup, rsync, procps-ng via apk on node1, node2, node3 (no prior DB software existed)
Initialized datadirs with mysql_install_db on all three nodes
Wrote /etc/my.cnf.d/galera.cnf on each node with wsrep_cluster_address=gcomm://node1,node2,node3, per-node wsrep_node_address/name, wsrep_sst_method=mariabackup, and wsrep_sst_auth

Diagnosed and fixed two Alpine-specific SST blockers: default skip-networking in mariadb-server.cnf (disabled it) and BusyBox ps lacking -p support which broke wsrep_sst_mariabackup's parent-liveness check (fixed by installing procps-ng)
Created dedicated sst MariaDB user for mariabackup SST auth (password generated on-node, propagated via secret_env)
Bootstrapped node1 as first cluster member (--wsrep-new-cluster), then joined node2 and node3 via mariabackup SST; verified wsrep_cluster_size=3 and Synced on all nodes
Enabled mariadb in the default OpenRC runlevel on all three nodes so the service auto-starts after any reboot
Created appdb.orders table and inserted rows from node1 and node3, confirming multi-master replication across all three nodes
Performed the full maintenance-window shutdown: stopped node2, then node3, then node1 last, confirming node1 ended with grastate.dat safe_to_bootstrap:1 and the highest seqno (18)
Verified all three nodes had zero mariadbd processes running (complete cluster outage)

Brought the cluster back: bootstrapped node1 from its saved state (row count still 4), then rc-service start on node2 and node3 which rejoined via IST/SST; verified wsrep_cluster_size=3, Synced, and all 4 rows present on every node
Captured pre-restart baseline (boot_id, wsrep_cluster_size=3, wsrep_cluster_status=Primary, Synced, row count) on all three nodes

Restarted node1 via native `reboot`, polled until exec was available again, confirmed boot_id changed, confirmed mariadb auto-started via OpenRC and rejoined the cluster (size 3, Synced, 4 rows) before proceeding
Restarted node2 via native `reboot`, confirmed boot_id changed, confirmed rejoin to a healthy 3-member Synced cluster with 4 rows before proceeding
Restarted node3 via native `reboot`, confirmed boot_id changed, confirmed rejoin to a healthy 3-member Synced cluster with 4 rows
Final verification pass on all three nodes simultaneously: wsrep_cluster_size=3, wsrep_cluster_status=Primary, wsrep_local_state_comment=Synced, identical 4-row appdb.orders table on every node

evidence.requirement: 3-member Galera cluster built and holding application data
evidence.summary: MariaDB+Galera installed and bootstrapped on node1, joined by node2 and node3 via mariabackup SST reaching cluster_size=3/Synced; appdb.orders table created with rows written from both node1 and node3 and confirmed identical on all three nodes

evidence.requirement: Full cluster shutdown for maintenance window
evidence.summary: All three nodes stopped in sequence (node2, node3, node1) via rc-service mariadb stop; node1 (last to stop) shows grastate.dat safe_to_bootstrap:1 with highest seqno 18; process list confirms zero mariadbd processes on any node -- complete outage

evidence.requirement: Cluster brought back with every committed write present and all three members serving
evidence.summary: node1 bootstrapped from saved state showed COUNT(*)=4 immediately after restart; node2 and node3 rejoined via IST reaching cluster_size=3/Synced; final cross-node check shows wsrep_cluster_status=Primary and identical 4-row orders table (including the node3-originated 'dave' row) on all three nodes

Baseline boot_id 1c28ca5a...; reboot acknowledged (stream closed before disconnect); post-reboot boot_id 3074cd1e... (changed); mariadb auto-started via OpenRC as SST joiner and reached cluster_size=3/Synced with 4 rows
Baseline boot_id 98cd4d6f...; reboot acknowledged; post-reboot boot_id 4dfa5767... (changed); rejoined cluster reaching size=3/Synced with 4 rows intact
